CREATE TABLE magic_formula_universe_snapshots (
                universe_snapshot_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, reference_date TEXT NOT NULL,
                universe_policy_version TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
                document_digest TEXT NOT NULL
            )

CREATE TRIGGER universe_no_delete
                    BEFORE DELETE ON magic_formula_universe_snapshots
                    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'IMMUTABLE_UNIVERSE_SNAPSHOT'); END

CREATE TRIGGER universe_no_update
                    BEFORE UPDATE ON magic_formula_universe_snapshots
                    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'IMMUTABLE_UNIVERSE_SNAPSHOT'); END
